summary: Source observations define current code/documented behavior; expected observations are acceptance criteria, not verified results.

cases.source_observation: Source: inactive button labelled Start calls requestStart; permission flow precedes service start.
cases.preconditions: Paired phone, inactive service, launcher foreground; TalkBack enabled.
cases.expected_observation: Start announces button and disabled/enabled state; activation never silently begins recording without foreground consent.

cases.source_observation: Source: RECORD_AUDIO denial stops wantsStart and sets mic-required local message.
cases.preconditions: Paired phone, RECORD_AUDIO denied; activate visible Start.
cases.expected_observation: Permission denial conveyed audibly and visually; focus returns to Start or actionable explanation; mic remains off.
cases.rollback: Revoke or restore permission in Android settings; End if active.

cases.source_observation: Source: active-state buttons use dynamic Mute/Unmute labels and separate End action.
cases.preconditions: Active user-started test session; TalkBack and switch access available.
cases.expected_observation: Mute/Unmute role, current state and effect announced; End independently reachable within two focus steps after controls.
cases.rollback: Activate End and confirm foreground service stops.

cases.source_observation: Source: dismiss finishes controls, onStop does not end foreground session.
cases.preconditions: Active session; close bottom sheet or background activity.
cases.expected_observation: Dismiss does not masquerade as End; active microphone state remains discoverable via notification and End action.

cases.source_observation: Source: scanner cancellation/failure callbacks, failed scanner shows local error.
cases.preconditions: Device without ready scanner module or with scanner download denied; unpaired.
cases.expected_observation: QR failure is announced, focus not trapped, paste/review link remains independently discoverable.
cases.rollback: Close scanner; discard test pairing link.

cases.source_observation: Source: masked pairing field, review dialog, explicit confirm; process-local pending link.
cases.preconditions: Open user-owned test pairing link and Review pairing with TalkBack.
cases.expected_observation: Announce trusted HTTPS origin but never speak or expose bearer token in accessibility labels/screenshots; Cancel does not pair.
cases.rollback: Cancel, forget paired test device and revoke token server-side.

cases.source_observation: Source: pending network renders Tailscale and Retry preferences.
cases.preconditions: Test desktop unreachable while an owner-started session is pending.
cases.expected_observation: Network failure communicated without repeating misleading VPN claims; Tailscale and Retry independently focusable.

cases.source_observation: Source: snapshot.error is displayed as text; token revocation handling is service-owned.
cases.preconditions: Revoke test device token during a running session and return to controls.
cases.expected_observation: Error distinguished from muted/connected; no false success announcement or hidden restart of mic.
cases.rollback: End, re-pair explicitly only after consent.

cases.source_observation: Source: status and caption use polite liveRegion semantics; caption selection is scrollable.
cases.preconditions: User-started synthetic test session with changing captions; TalkBack on.
cases.expected_observation: New status/caption announced once without focus theft, with navigable scroll and no private text captured.
cases.rollback: End and erase disposable test transcript locally.

cases.source_observation: Source: localMessage/snapshot.error rendered as red Text without explicit liveRegion.
cases.preconditions: Induce recoverable storage/network failure; screen reader running.
cases.expected_observation: Failure and recovery announced, readable without color, focus reaches recovery action. Source may need Hermes-owned UI repair.

cases.source_observation: Source: Start and active Mute/End occupy a responsive Row; controls can scroll.
cases.preconditions: Set Android font size 200% and narrow portrait/landscape orientations.
cases.expected_observation: No clipped Start, End, Mute, captions, errors or pairing actions; visible accessible stop at all sizes.

cases.source_observation: Source: settings use ClickablePreference, SwitchPreference and confirmation AlertDialog.
cases.preconditions: Keyboard or Switch Access enabled; navigate z0live settings.
cases.expected_observation: Logical focus order, visible focus, keyboard activation and consent Cancel; no auto-grant on focus.
cases.rollback: Dismiss dialog; disable testing switch access.

cases.source_observation: Source: ModalBottomSheet and status changes; animation accessibility not established by source.
cases.preconditions: Enable Android Remove animations/reduced motion and screen reader.
cases.expected_observation: No motion-only state information, service stop independent of animation, dialog focus returns predictably.

cases.source_observation: Documented: ACTION_ASSIST/explicit fallback opens external assistant; no audio forwarding.
cases.preconditions: Configure system assistant; use QSB and assistant handoff while TalkBack active.
cases.expected_observation: Handoff labelled and announces destination; no assertion that external assistant received previous utterance.
cases.rollback: Return to HOME; close external assistant.

cases.source_observation: Source: current space indicated by subtitle; Scratch is separately selectable.
cases.preconditions: Create test Build space, activate Scratch; TalkBack on.
cases.expected_observation: Selected/current named-space and transient Scratch state announced; moving between tabs does not imply independent desktops.
cases.rollback: Switch back to Now; clear Scratch by leaving it.

cases.source_observation: Source: pin row offers title click and separate generic Unpin TextButton.
cases.preconditions: Pin two synthetic visible apps with different names.
cases.expected_observation: Each Unpin control announces the associated app distinctly; deletion requires no ambiguous focus, confirms changed list.

cases.source_observation: Source: uses personal profile and hidden-app filter on resume/launch.
cases.preconditions: Create disposable hidden/uninstalled/work-profile app and revisit Spaces.
cases.expected_observation: No identifying hidden/work-profile labels or invokable shortcuts; disabled item handled without leaking target.
cases.rollback: Restore app/profile visibility and remove test pins.

cases.source_observation: Source: compact view switches to advanced controls; feature is opt-in downstream.
cases.preconditions: Install exact test APK, compare Spaces enabled/disabled with widget/folder/hotseat baseline.
cases.expected_observation: Original home controls, icons, widgets, folders, hotseat and search remain reachable with accessible roles.
cases.rollback: Restore earlier signed APK or One UI Home fallback without deleting saved layout.
